pkgmetadata.longdescription: computer-use-linux is a Model Context Protocol server that lets an agent operate a Linux desktop. It reads the AT-SPI accessibility tree for semantic element selection, targets windows through the compositor specific interfaces of GNOME, KWin, Hyprland, i3 and COSMIC, takes screenshots through the desktop portal, and synthesises input with the RemoteDesktop portal, ydotool or xdotool. Wayland works through the portals, X11 is supported on a best-effort basis.

computer-use-linux 是一个 Model Context Protocol 服务程序，让智能体能够 操作 Linux 桌面。它通过 AT-SPI 无障碍树做语义化元素定位，针对 GNOME、KWin、 Hyprland、i3 和 COSMIC 各自的合成器接口控制窗口，借助桌面 portal 截屏， 并使用 RemoteDesktop portal、ydotool 或 xdotool 合成输入。Wayland 通过 portal 支持，X11 按尽力而为的方式支持。
